population: Distinct non-placeholder anonymous_session_id across the existing 17 allowed product event names received in [start,end); includes sessions without PAGE_VIEW
deduplication: Each session contributes at most once to each metric; ordering and number of offers/plans/actions do not change the count

metrics.not: DEAL_VIEW visits or offer impression CTR
completion / BUDGET_USE conversion or verified supplier prices
update / TRIP_SAVE conversion or returning-person metric

percentage: 100 * numerator / denominator, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimals; JSON string
zero_received_actions: When denominator>0 and numerator=0: percent=0.00, status=available; says nothing about actual usage or event collection coverage
compatibility: New optional engagement root field with version; old metrics array, page_cohorts and ordered_funnel definitions unchanged
window_limits: Existing UTC default7/max31days and MAX_USAGE_EVENTS=20000; over limit rejects413 without truncating
privacy: No new event collection, identifiers or metadata; no raw session/plan/offer IDs, labels, amounts, tokens or arbitrary metadata in output
interpretation: Received-session action shares, not cross-step conversion, all-visitor estimates, bookings, causal attribution, or uplift. Compare only matching taxonomy/coverage periods
baseline: Synthetic only; no production before/after collected
